jobs.title: 常公公
jobs.prompt: Edit image 1: remove his beard and moustache completely. His chin, jaw, cheeks and upper lip become smooth, pale and completely hairless, like an elderly palace eunuch. Keep everything else exactly the same: the same face, eyes, wrinkles, white hair at the temples, black cap, dark teal robe, pose, lighting, framing and dark smoky blue-grey backdrop. Clean image with nothing written anywhere.
